biggest_catch: Promo code SUMMER200 is mandatory at checkout and the card arrives only after 90 consecutive days of active, good-standing service — it is value on a fiber subscription, not income.
catches: Gift card only valid with an order of a 1, 2 or 5 GIG plan with promo code SUMMER200 at checkout.
Customer must remain active and in good standing for 90 consecutive days to qualify.
Redemption instructions are emailed after 90 days; the customer chooses between an Amazon or Mastercard gift card — the card is not automatic or instant.
Limit one gift card per household; gift card subject to issuer terms.
The 600 Mbps plan gets 1 month free only — no gift card on that tier.

steps: Check availability at gatewayfiber.com and select a 1, 2 or 5 GIG fiber plan (1 Month Free included on all tiers).
Apply promo code SUMMER200 at checkout.
Keep service active and in good standing for 90 consecutive days.
After 90 days, receive an email with redemption instructions.
Choose an Amazon or Mastercard gift card in the $200 qualifying amount.
timing: One-time; redemption email arrives after 90 consecutive days of active, good-standing service.
